summary: Assay worksheet for MV-2006-090, the NM08 paired liver systems study for Nimbravelle Medicines Inc: 24 aminotriazine analogues run in microsomal and cryopreserved hepatocyte CLint, with the accession-lot mapping and matrix acceptance checks. Microsomal and hepatocyte rankings agree for most of the set; the analogues Nimbravelle advanced are the ones with slower hepatocyte turnover that also rank well in microsomes.

analogues, all run in both systems
